title: English Listening Practice | Build a Relationship with English | B1-B2

lines.text: Hello.
Let's practice intermediate listening.
Listen first,
then shadow along.
Welcome back to my Slow English podcast.

If you want more of a challenge, then
speed this video up to 1.25
Today I want to talk about a book that
I've been reading about nature,
gratitude,
and the way that we see the world.
And I think the relationship that we
have with languages
is pretty similar.
Sometimes we see English as
another course,
another subscription,
another thing we need to buy to become
fluent in English. But language isn't a
product.
It's a relationship.
And I think the moment we start treating
English as a relationship, a
relationship with people,
with stories like mine, with culture,
with yourself, the moment we start
treating language like a relationship,
everything changes. So today, while you
practice your listening with me

It changed the way I see the world. It

feel responsible

your grandma

gratitude,

of course, I'm going to feel

to look at the world. To look at the

pay

attention, and presence,
